main_issue: Whether the shared house fund should pay for the alcohol for the housewarming, and then how to arrange food for everyone's guests.

A-B.evidence: B said A's offer to cover alcohol 'sounds fair' (8); B and A then agreed together on ordering halal, Chinese and Indian food (13, 17, 18). B had no prior stated position against A.

A-C.evidence: C questioned using the fund for alcohol (3, 5); A offered to pay for alcohol personally (7); C replied 'that works. Thanks' (9).

A-D.evidence: D said they don't drink either (6); A then offered to cover alcohol (7), and A accepted D's Indian food idea (17).

B-C.evidence: B accepted A's fix, as C did (8, 9); B proposed halal food for C's side (11, 13) and C said 'that's a good idea' (14).

B-D.evidence: B raised no beef for D's side (11); D added Indian food to B's plan (16) and B said 'good' (18).

C-D.evidence: C questioned alcohol from the fund (3, 5) and D said 'Yeah, I don't drink either' (6); both were satisfied by A's fix, and C agreed with the food plan that D extended (14, 16).
